name: cisa_kev
license: U.S. Government work - public domain (CISA terms of use apply)
notes: Catalog of CVEs with evidence of active exploitation, plus mandated federal remediation deadlines. Highly authoritative, small and frequently updated - ideal RAG seed content.

name: cyberllm_sft
license: MIT (code); underlying records retain their original licences
notes: Present in the repository at dataset/final/cyberllm_train.jsonl. Instruction/response pairs only - network-flow tables are never mixed into language-model training data.

name: mitre_attack
license: Apache-2.0 / MITRE ATT&CK terms of use (attribution required)
notes: Adversary tactics, techniques and procedures, distributed as a STIX 2.1 bundle from the official mitre/cti repository. Attribution to MITRE ATT&CK is required in any derivative work.

name: nvd_cve
license: U.S. Government work - NVD terms permit free use with attribution
notes: Official NVD REST API. A free API key raises the rate limit from ~5 requests/30s to 50/30s. Without a key the API still works, just slowly - set CYBERLLM_NVD_MAX_RECORDS to a small number when keyless.

name: phishing_urls
license: PhishTank developer terms - attribution required, see source
notes: URLs are analysed entirely offline. CyberLLM never fetches a submitted URL and never contacts PhishTank unless the operator supplies their own registered API key.

name: unsw_nb15
license: UNSW dataset terms - academic use, citation required
notes: Ten attack classes plus normal traffic. Contains both real and synthetic (tool-generated) flows - the synthetic portion is a documented caveat when reporting accuracy.

name: cic_ids2017
license: CIC datasets - free for research/educational use with citation
notes: Labelled CSVs generated by running attacks against a victim network. Very large; consider preprocessing a single day to bound disk and training time.

name: cic_malmem_2022
license: CIC datasets - free for research/educational use with citation
notes: Volatile-memory (RAM) artefacts from 12 malware families plus benign families, including obfuscation variants. Malware samples are NEVER executed by CyberLLM; only pre-extracted feature tables are used.

name: cse_cic_ids2018
license: CIC datasets - free for research/educational use with citation
notes: Larger than CIC-IDS2017 and includes infiltration attacks. Multi-gigabyte download.
